highlights: The Dashboard update button works again. On 4.0.17 and 4.0.18 it failed immediately at step 1 and could never install anything, including this fix.
Hosts on 4.0.17 or 4.0.18 must update once from the command line to reach 4.0.19; the in-portal updater works normally from then on.
The signed release evidence, key fingerprint, and exact installer bytes are still authenticated before any downloaded installer executes.
